يغتدوا (form VIII)
# يَغْتَدُوا (yaḡtadū) /jaɣ.ta.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# يُغْتَدَوْا (yuḡtadaw) /juɣ.ta.daw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
